definitions.explanation: Describes doing something frequently, regularly, and without neglect. Implies conscientiousness and attentiveness to small tasks.

examples.japanese: こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}になる→楽になる：26083_rakuninaru⟧。
examples.english: If you clean frequently, the big cleaning becomes easier.

notes:
Na-adjective: こまめな + noun, こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}{補給|ほきゅう}→水分補給：14832_suibunhokyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hydrate frequently
- こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to keep in touch regularly
- こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean frequently
- こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash hands frequently
- こまめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to save (files) frequently
- こまめな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a diligent/attentive person

NUANCE: こまめ has a positive connotation, implying someone who doesn't neglect small but important tasks. It suggests steady, consistent effort rather than grand gestures. A こまめな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ is someone who stays on top of things through regular small actions.
